steps.sql: SET NOCOUNT OFF; CREATE TABLE output_ref(id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,n INT NULL,t NVARCHAR(4) NULL); INSERT INTO output_ref VALUES(10,1,N'one'),(20,2,N'two'); CREATE TABLE output_sink(a INT NOT NULL,b INT NULL); CREATE TABLE lookup(id INT NOT NULL,n INT NOT NULL); INSERT INTO lookup VALUES(10,50),(20,60)
UPDATE t SET n=COALESCE((SELECT q.n+extra FROM lookup q WHERE q.id=t.id),n) OUTPUT deleted.id,deleted.n,inserted.n,s.extra FROM output_ref t LEFT JOIN (VALUES(10,7)) s(id,extra) ON t.id=s.id
SELECT id,n,t FROM output_ref ORDER BY id; SELECT a,b FROM output_sink ORDER BY a,b
